_comment: Local, developer-maintained description of what is queryable in your KMS tenant. The getData API has no live discovery endpoint, so this file is the source of truth for content/profile/tag types and for cached tag name -> ObjectId mappings used by filters. Copy this to kms_schema.json (or point KMS_SCHEMA_PATH at your own) and edit. Values seeded here are illustrative examples taken from the API documentation.

content_types.name: Stories
content_types.description: Field stories, often with an author reference at meta.kp_contributed_by.

profile_types.name: Volunteers
profile_types.description: Volunteer user profiles. Often tagged with locations like states.

tag_types.name: Countries
tag_types.description: Country tags. Content can be tagged with countries.

tag_types.name: States
tag_types.description: State tags (e.g. for rollups: cities -> states -> countries).

tag_types.name: Cities
tag_types.description: City tags. Content is often tagged at the city level.
